1\. Instance setup errors suppressed 🐞 Bug ☼ Reliability 
create_app now suppresses every OSError, including permission failures and cases where the
instance path is a file, instead of only tolerating an existing directory. The application then
starts successfully but later fails when SQLite opens the database under that unusable path,
obscuring the actual setup failure.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description The instance-directory setup catches every `OSError`, hiding failures that mean the directory was not created and is unusable. ## Issue Context The database defaults to a file inside `app.instance_path`, so directory setup failures must propagate. Restore `os.makedirs(app.instance_path, exist_ok=True)`, which tolerates an existing directory while preserving other errors. ## Fix Focus Areas - examples/tutorial/flaskr/__init__.py[23-27] ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools
